text_block_list.text:
Marvelous Sunday's conditioning is 
proceeding smoothly.

Compared to the first half of the Classic 
season when training didn't go as
planned, 
her abilities had noticeably improved.

Marvelous Sunday watches Mayano Top Gun's 
training intently with burning eyes.
Right 
now, she should be more than ready to 
compete on the big stage.

Let her fully convey the wonders of 
'Marvelous' to the world on the Kikuka
Sho 
stage.
